findings.detail: The extractor assigned the par amount currency prefix (CAD/GBP) to cost_currency even though cost is a separate dollar-denominated amortized cost column.

rationale: Class 2 row-level currency localization. The SOI header separates Par Amount / Shares from Amortized Cost and Fair Value, and the cited rows place CAD or GBP only in the par amount cell before separate amortized cost and fair value amounts. Therefore cost_currency=U_CAD/U_GBP is a real extraction/field-mapping error, not a valid non-USD cost amount.
